title: Textual replacement proof gate
delivered_promises: Audited PRES-X01 through PRES-X07 report coverage before gate closure.

Proved legacy TUI fallback remains fenced behind explicit selection or permitted missing-Textual auto fallback.

Retained --explain-backend as the diagnostic path for backend selection.
Proved Textual feature parity has no missing required current-TUI features.
Proved cross-surface presentation parity remains consistent.
Proved Textual remains renderer/interaction only and does not own RUN, EXO, RER, validation, or ENV truth.
